title: Machine Learning-Based Cyber Defense for Cloud Infrastructure: An Adaptive Deep Q-Network Architecture for Intelligent Intrusion Detection and Automated Threat Mitigation
abstract: arXiv:2608.12190v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: With the increasing complexity of cyber assaults in cloud environments, adaptable security solutions are needed that can support real-time detection and autonomous response. In this paper, we propose a reinforcement learning-based dynamic cyber defense framework. We deploy a Deep Q-Network (DQN) to train effective defensive strategies to counteract the evolving cyberattacks. We leverage the CICIDS2017 dataset for model creation and the UNSW-NB15 dataset for external validation, involving preprocessing of data, feature engineering, and adaptive policy learning. We compare the proposed DQN with decision tree, support vector machine, random forest, XGBoost, and multilayer perceptron models. The proposed DQN achieves an accuracy of 99.72%, a precision of 99.68%, a recall of 99.65%, an F1-score of 99.66%, and an ROC-AUC of 0.999, while the false positive rate is 0.31%, the false negative rate is 0.35%, and the detection latency is 15 ms. translated_title: 基于机器学习的云基础设施网络防御：一种用于智能入侵检测和自动威胁缓解的自适应深度Q网络架构
translated_abstract: 随着云环境中网络攻击的日益复杂，需要能够支持实时检测和自主响应的适应性安全解决方案。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于强化学习的动态网络防御框架。我们部署了深度Q网络（DQN）来训练有效的防御策略，以应对不断演变的网络攻击。我们利用CICIDS2017数据集进行模型创建，并使用UNSW-NB15数据集进行外部验证，涉及数据预处理、特征工程和自适应策略学习。我们将所提出的DQN与决策树、支持向量机、随机森林、XGBoost和多层感知器模型进行了比较。所提出的DQN实现了99.72%的准确率、99.68%的精确率、99.65%的召回率、99.66%的F1分数和0.999的ROC-AUC，同时误报率为0.31%，漏报率为0.35%，检测延迟为15毫秒。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于深度Q网络的强化学习动态网络防御框架，在云环境中实现了99.72%的检测准确率和15毫秒的低延迟，显著优于传统机器学习模型。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a reinforcement learning-based dynamic cyber defense framework using Deep Q-Network, achieving 99.72% detection accuracy and 15ms low latency in cloud environments, significantly outperforming traditional machine learning models.
